finding_fixed_here.finding: [minor] clipping - at 760 the header 'Back to ...' button ellipsized its label while ~170-190px of empty header sat immediately to its right, dropping the words that carry the meaning ('Back to AI Brains & ...' lost 'Providers'). Present on all sixteen non-home 760 shots of the audited themes.
finding_fixed_here.root_cause: .c05.is-narrow .c05-back-label carried an unconditional max-width:120px. The clamp was width-class driven, not space driven, so it fired whenever the layout was narrow regardless of how much room the row actually had. The full label needs only 17-37px more than the clamped width, against 168-186px of free space.
finding_fixed_here.fix: Removed the fixed clamp. .c05-back-label now carries overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis with min-width:max-content, so at rest it always renders its whole text (the max-content floor also defeats the sub-pixel flex rounding that would otherwise paint a spurious ellipsis, the same hazard the crumb trail hit). .c05-back is pinned flex:0 0 auto so the button can never be flex-shaved out from under its own text. The row's real yielders go first: the topbar search field already shrinks at flex-shrink 4 to its 170px floor, then the crumb trail truncates via syncCrumbTight(). Only a shortfall that survives both reaches the label: the new syncBackFit() measures the trailing element's overhang past the header's content edge and, if positive, adds .is-back-tight (which releases the max-content floor) and assigns an integer max-width equal to the overhang, never taking the label below a 96px floor that keeps 'Back to' plus the leading word readable. The button's title attribute already carries the full text for that case. The two clamps can never chase each other: syncTopFit() clears the Back clamp, runs the crumb pass, then runs the Back pass, so every measurement is taken from the fully untruncated state. syncTopFit() replaced syncCrumbTight() at both call sites (updateLayout, renderTop).
finding_fixed_here.measured_after: CDP geometry probe over all 8 themes x the 4 non-home routes at 760 (32 cases): label.scrollWidth == clientWidth in every one (truncated=false, .is-back-tight never set), labels reading in full as 'Back to Settings Home' / 'Back to AI Brains & Providers'. Button widths 164-215px depending on theme font; the freed space now sits in the flexible spacer (113-184px), and the trailing element lands exactly on the header content edge (lastRight == contentRight == 748) with docOverflow 0 in all 32. Pixel decode of the regenerated shots agrees: basic-dark-760 dest/ai back box x48-224 with ink to x213 (was box x48-207, ink ending x174 at an ellipsis), retro-light-760 manager/m.providers box x48-246 with ink to x235 (was 48-209 / ink 181).
finding_fixed_here.still_ellipsizes_when_genuinely_tight: At 520 the cascade is visible in order: the search field is at its 170px floor first, and only then does the label clamp (truncated=true, .is-back-tight set, 'Back to AI Brai...'), with the row still fitting inside the header padding and docOverflow 0.

Seven confirmed findings from the independent audit (3 major, 4 minor); six are fixed here, one was already fixed upstream in this file and is re-verified below.

already_fixed_upstream_reverified.finding: [major] affordance - the 'Open' action in the manager NEEDS ATTENTION list rendered in plain body ink in all four audited themes, and parent breadcrumbs lost their muting, because `.c05 button { color: inherit }` at specificity (0,1,1) out-ranked 14 single-class component colour rules.
already_fixed_upstream_reverified.state_found: already rewrapped as `:where(.c05 button)` (0,0,0) at line 28 of this stylesheet before this pass began.
already_fixed_upstream_reverified.reverified: Fresh matrix shots at 1280 confirm the pixels in every theme: 'Open' now paints --accent-primary (friendly-dark #6FC6E8 sky against a 14.18:1 body sentence; glass-dark, retro-light and basic-dark likewise show a chromatic accent where the audit measured an identical grey), and the breadcrumb trail reads muted-muted-bright again (parents --text-muted, .is-here --text-primary at 600).
already_fixed_upstream_reverified.fallout_audit: Every button class emitted by the JS was enumerated (30 classes) and cross-checked against the stylesheet's colour rules. Exactly one - .c05-jump - declares an accent colour, so 'Open' is the only control that newly paints accent; nothing that should stay neutral turned accented. The other 13 rules the defeat had suppressed all resolve DOWN the ramp, not up: .c05-back/.c05-close/.c05-mini/.c05-more/.c05-foot-link/.c05-mgr-backlist/.c05-adv-toggle/.c05-rail-item -> --text-secondary, .c05-crumb/.c05-tab/.c05-attn-more/.c05-x -> --text-muted, each with an explicit .is-active/.is-here/:hover restatement back to --text-primary. .c05-btn already declared --text-primary explicitly and is unchanged. .c05-card, .c05-attn-row, .c05-result, .c05-recent, .c05-menu-item, .c05-mgr-obj, .c05-all-main, .c05-act-btn, .c05-banner-act, .c05-dest-row, .c05-rel-link and .c05-select declare no colour at all, so they still inherit exactly as before.

findings_fixed_here.finding: [major] proximity - the manager NEEDS ATTENTION key/value list broke label-to-value pairing in BOTH of its layout states, and the key was dimmer than its own value.
findings_fixed_here.root_cause: .c05-kv was a wrapping flex row (flex-wrap: wrap, gap 12px) whose key carried a fixed `width: min(240px, 38%)`. That produced two coexisting layouts inside one list. Short value: the value column was pinned 249px from the key's left edge, leaving measured dead runs of 190px (Cursor CLI, 58px key), 163px (Antigravity CLI) and 97px (Free & community models) between a label and the value it owns. Long value: flex line-breaking uses the item's hypothetical content width, so it fired before the author's `min-width: 0` shrink could apply and dropped the value onto a full-width line at the SAME left margin as the key - 20px below the key, 17px above the muted note, i.e. equidistant between the thing it belongs to and the thing it does not. Ink was inverted on top of that: .c05-kv-k was --text-secondary/600 while .c05-kv-v inherited --text-primary.
findings_fixed_here.fix: The row is now a two-track grid, `minmax(0, max-content) minmax(0, 1fr)` with a 12px column gap, and the key is capped at 240px. Track 1 is the key's own content width, so no dead run can open; track 2 is the only place a value can live, so it can never break to its own line - long values wrap inside the track and hang under themselves. The note spans both tracks with a 10px top margin against the pair's 0px internal gap. The key is --text-primary at weight 700 and the value inherits the same --text-primary at 400.
findings_fixed_here.why_not_text_secondary_for_the_value: A --text-secondary value was tried first and rejected on measurement: glass-light's --text-secondary composites to (50,40,65) = 7.44:1 on the pane while its --text-primary is (69,58,92) = 5.60:1, so the token pair is inverted in that theme and the value would have out-inked its key again - the exact defect being fixed. Weight cannot invert; ink tokens can. The subordination is therefore carried by weight (700 vs 400) and the third level (--text-muted note) is unchanged.
findings_fixed_here.measured_after: CDP geometry over all 8 themes x the 5 NEEDS ATTENTION rows of manager/m.providers at 1280: key-to-value gap is exactly 12px in 40/40 cases (was 97-190px inline, or a full-width line break), sameLine is true in 40/40 (was false for Claude and GitHub Copilot in every theme), value-to-note is 10px in 40/40. Key computes --text-primary/700 and value --text-primary/400 in all 8 themes; peak-ink on the friendly-dark shot reads key 14.18:1 with the value at the same fill.

findings_fixed_here.finding: [major] dead-desert-at-wide-widths - Home was hard-capped so roughly half the settings pane was empty background at 2200/2500, the destination grid stayed 2-up, and six of the twelve destinations were pushed below the fold.
findings_fixed_here.root_cause: .c05-home { max-width: 1080px } with zero media queries and no width class above is-tight (the JS only set is-narrow < 920 and is-tight 920-1199). The same 1080px column therefore rendered at 1280, 1700, 2200 and 2500.
findings_fixed_here.fix: Two new stage-width classes and a composed layout for each. is-wide (1300-1959): the column opens to 1780px and the directory goes 3-up. is-ultra (>= 1960): the page becomes a real two-column composition - directory left on an auto-fill track (3-up at the bottom of the band, 4-up from ~2200), and the utility band promoted from a footer strip into a bordered right-hand panel carrying All Settings, Copy Settings and Recent changes - inside a 2160px bound. Head, hero search, banner and the attention band stay full-bleed rows; source order already puts attention above both, so plain row auto-placement lands the grid in column 1 and the panel in column 2 of the same row without any DOM change. is-wide starts at 1300 rather than at the 1080 cap so the 1208-wide stage a 1280 window produces - the audit's reference layout - is bit-for-bit untouched.
findings_fixed_here.measured_after: CDP geometry on friendly-dark home across 11 viewport widths (stage width in brackets), same stage-relative metric the audit used. BEFORE: the column measured 1080px at every width from 1280 up - 1280 [1208] 10.6% of the pane empty, 1700 [1628] 33.7%, 2200 [2128] 49.3%, 2500 [2428] 55.5% - 2-up throughout, and only 6 of the 12 destinations visible at the widest sizes. AFTER: 1280 [1208] default, 1080px, 2-up, 535px cards, 10.6% - the audited reference layout, unchanged; 1370 [1298] default, 16.8% (the last width still on the untouched 1080 measure, and the worst residual anywhere in the ladder); 1372 [1300] is-wide, 1220px, 3-up, 400px cards, 6.2%; 1571 [1499] is-wide, 1419px, 3-up, 466px, 5.3% (28.0% with the first-draft 1500 threshold, which is why the step was moved down to 1300); 1700 [1628] is-wide, 1548px, 3-up, 509px, 4.9%; 2030 and 2031 [1958/1959] is-wide, 1780px, 3-up, 587px, 9.1%; 2200 [2128] is-ultra, 2048px, 4-up plus the utility panel, 408px cards, 3.8%; 2500 [2428] is-ultra, 2160px, 4-up plus the utility panel, 436px cards, 11.0%. All 12 destination cards sit fully above the 900px fold at 2200 and 2500 (was 6), and all 12 titles are visible from 1571 up. 760 [724] and 900 [828] stay is-narrow and are untouched.
